question: In a certain code language, '893' means 'Shahid likes cakes', '137' means 'cakes are delicious', and '274' means 'we are girls'. Which of the following options may be the code for 'girls'?
solution:
According to the given information

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fab069d542b27e4f729a046af824d110065d735af609a7f2afa491f6d2f6c426.png]
